column1: # libultra 2.0D, fingerprints of library functions found byte for byte (relocations aside) in 3 or more games whose ROM header declares libultra 2.0D, and in no archive of the SDK folder (2.0H-2.0L): named by the instruction sequence of the function of that name in those archives, one name per fingerprint (hashes, sizes and names; no code)
